subject.title: exec private-LAN access fails while same user GUI/LaunchAgent succeeds

question: Should this issue be resolved by the diagnostic-only exec warning in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/94045, or should OpenClaw pursue same-user private-LAN reachability parity for gateway-host exec?
rationale: Source inspection can prove the missing diagnostic, but allowing or deliberately blocking private-LAN exec traffic is a security-boundary and product-policy choice that automation should not choose.

options.title: Land diagnostic only
options.body: Review and land the open diagnostic PR while keeping private-LAN access semantics unchanged and separately tracked.

options.title: Design access parity
options.body: Treat same-user GUI/LaunchAgent reachability as the product goal and require a security design before implementation.

options.title: Defer to broader policy trackers
options.body: Reject a diagnostic-only resolution and keep this issue under the broader private-network policy/security discussions.

recommendation.title: Land diagnostic only
recommendation.body: Review and land the open diagnostic PR while keeping private-LAN access semantics unchanged and separately tracked.

likelyOwner.reason: This person has the strongest current-history signal across exec runtime ownership, docs, and security-sensitive product direction for this surface.
